methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page (accessed 2026-06-14 unless noted). Google Maps Platform subscription plans (Starter/Essentials/Pro) confirmed from mapsplatform.google.com/pricing; pay-as-you-go free-tier credits per SKU confirmed same page. Mapbox has no flat monthly subscription for API products — all billing is usage-metered; rates sourced from mapbox.com/pricing (multiple sub-sections). HERE Technologies pricing page (here.com/get-started/pricing) renders JavaScript-only and returned no data in repeated fetch attempts; HERE is therefore listed as quote-only (monthlyUsd=null for all plans). TomTom offers Freemium (free daily quota with no flat fee) and Pay As You Grow (usage-metered above that daily free quota); per-request rates sourced from developer.tomtom.com/store/maps-api. Radar publishes no self-serve pricing; pricing page only shows a demo/quote request form. MapTiler Cloud prices sourced from maptiler.com/cloud/pricing/. LocationIQ prices sourced from locationiq.com/pricing. Geoapify prices sourced from geoapify.com/pricing. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical. monthlyUsd for usage-metered plans with no flat tier = null; published unit rates are in notes.

vendors.name: Google Maps Platform
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://mapsplatform.google.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Subscription plan costs ($100/$275/$1,200/month) and included call counts (50K/100K/250K) confirmed directly. Enterprise is contact-sales only. Pay-as-you-go free tiers (10K/5K/1K per SKU per month) also confirmed.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 50,000 monthly API calls included. Covers Dynamic Maps and Geocoding APIs. New customers receive $300 trial credit. Savings up to $180 vs. pay-as-you-go.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: 100,000 monthly API calls included. Covers Geocoding, Autocomplete, Geolocation, Place Details, Maps SDK, Static Maps, Street View, Routes APIs, Air Quality, Solar, Weather. Pay-as-you-go free tier: 10,000 free calls per SKU per month (when not on subscription). Volume discounts start at 20% above 100K monthly requests.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 250,000 monthly API calls included. All Essentials features plus Address Validation Pro, Places Aggregate API, Nearby Search Pro, Text Search Pro, Immersive Maps, Aerial View, Dynamic Street View, Elevation, Roads APIs, Route Optimization, Pollen. Savings up to $5,000 vs. pay-as-you-go.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom monthly call limits, maximum feature set, full customization. Contact sales required.

vendors.name: Mapbox
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.mapbox.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. No flat monthly subscription plans exist for API products; all pricing is usage-metered. Multiple sub-sections fetched: /pricing#maps, /pricing#navigation, /pricing#search, /pricing#tilesets. Rates confirmed across two fetches of the same official source.

plans.name: Maps GL JS (Web)
plans.notes: Free up to 50,000 map loads/month. Overage: $5.00/1K loads (50K-100K), $4.00/1K (100K-200K), $3.00/1K (200K-1M), $2.50/1K (1M-5M); contact sales above 5M. monthlyUsd=0 reflects $0 base fee with usage billing above free tier.

plans.name: Maps SDK for Mobile
plans.notes: Free up to 25,000 monthly active users (MAU). Overage: $4.00/1K MAU (25K-125K), $3.20/1K (125K-250K), $2.40/1K (250K+); contact sales above 1.25M MAU.

plans.name: Directions API
plans.notes: Free up to 100,000 requests/month. Overage: $2.00/1K (100K-500K), tiering down to $1.20/1K at 1M+ requests. Same rates apply to Map Matching, Optimization, Matrix, and Isochrone APIs.

plans.name: Search Box API
plans.notes: Standard pricing (effective Q4 2025): free up to 2,500 sessions/month; $11.50/1K sessions (2.5K-100K), $10.00/1K (100K-200K), $8.40/1K (200K-500K), $6.60/1K (500K-1M). One session = up to 50 suggest calls + 1 retrieve call. Introductory preview price was $3.00/1K sessions until Q4 2025.

plans.name: Temporary Geocoding API
plans.notes: Free up to 100,000 requests/month. Overage: $0.75/1K (100K-500K), $0.60/1K (500K-1M), $0.45/1K above 1M. Permanent Geocoding API (results may be stored): $5.00/1K requests flat.

plans.name: Navigation SDK (Metered Trips)
plans.notes: Free up to 100 MAU and 1,000 trips/month. MAU overage: $0.30/user (101+). Trip overage: $0.08/trip (1K-50K), $0.064/trip (50K-100K), $0.048/trip (100K+). Unlimited-trips variant: free up to 10 MAU; contact sales above that.

plans.name: Support — Individual
plans.notes: 3 business-day first response. Optional paid add-on to any usage plan.

plans.name: Support — Business
plans.notes: 10% of monthly spend, minimum $500/month or $6,000/year. 1-3 business-day response, 4-hour emergency response.

plans.name: Support — Premium
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Dedicated support engineer, 30-minute emergency response, phone/video calls.

vendors.name: HERE Technologies
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.here.com/get-started/pricing fetched multiple times 2026-06-14. Page renders JavaScript-only (SPA) and returns only the page shell with no pricing data — plan names, costs, and request limits are not accessible via HTML fetch. No usable third-party pricing comparison page with specific HERE USD rates was found. HERE is therefore recorded as quote-only / custom pricing. Provenance: official page URL cited, noted as JS-only / did not render.

plans.name: Freemium / Base Plan
plans.notes: HERE advertises a free-to-start tier ('Get started for free') at here.com/get-started/pricing. Specific request limits and any overage rates could not be retrieved — the official pricing page is JavaScript-rendered and returned no data. Contact HERE or sign up at platform.here.com to see actual limits.

plans.name: Pay As You Grow
plans.notes: HERE advertises flexible pay-as-you-grow pricing above the free tier. Specific per-request USD rates could not be retrieved — official pricing page is JavaScript-rendered. Contact HERE for rates.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom contract. Contact HERE sales ('Tell us your unique needs, we'll help you find a solution').

vendors.name: TomTom
vendors.provenance: Official developer store https://developer.tomtom.com/store/maps-api fetched 2026-06-14. Daily free-tier limits (50,000 tile requests, 2,500 non-tile requests) and pay-as-you-go per-request rates for all API categories confirmed from the same page across two fetches.

plans.name: Freemium
plans.notes: No credit card required. Daily free quota: 50,000 tile requests + 2,500 non-tile requests. Usage above daily quota is blocked (not billed) unless prepaid credit is added via Pay As You Grow. Suitable for commercial applications with attribution.

plans.name: Pay As You Grow
plans.notes: Same daily free quota as Freemium. Prepaid credit unlocks usage above daily limit. Per-1,000-request rates: Map display tiles $0.08, Map display non-tile $0.75; Geocoding $0.75, Reverse Geocoding $0.50, Fuzzy/POI Search $2.50; Standard Routing $0.75, Waypoint Optimization $4.00, Long Distance EV Routing $6.00; Traffic tiles $0.08, Traffic non-tile $0.75; Geofencing/Notifications/Location History $0.75 each, Snap to Roads $2.50. Prepaid amounts valid for one year. monthlyUsd=0 reflects $0 base fee; billing is usage-metered above the daily free quota.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom contract tailored to business needs. Includes dedicated account manager, flexible QPS limits (default 5-50 depending on API), data licensing options, and dedicated support engineer. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Radar
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://radar.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Page shows only a demo/quote request form with no published pricing tiers or rates. Radar states 'easy-to-understand pricing based on monthly API calls or monthly tracked users (MTU)' and 'rates go down as you scale' but publishes no specific numbers. Contact page also showed only a demo booking form. No usable third-party source with specific Radar USD rates was found. All plans recorded as quote-only (monthlyUsd=null).

plans.name: Custom / Quote
plans.notes: Radar prices on MTU (monthly tracked users) and/or monthly API calls with volume discounts. No self-serve pricing published. Claims up to 50% savings vs. legacy geolocation platforms. Get a quote at radar.com/contact.

vendors.name: MapTiler
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.maptiler.com/cloud/pricing/ fetched twice 2026-06-14. Plan names, monthly costs, session/request limits, and overage rates all confirmed from page content. Custom plan is prepaid/contract; no public rate.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5,000 API sessions/month and 100,000 API requests/month included. 100 MB hosting. MapTiler logo required on maps. No overage — service halts on quota exhaustion. Non-commercial use.

plans.name: Flex
plans.notes: 25,000 API sessions/month and 500,000 API requests/month included. 10 GB hosting. Commercial use allowed. Overage: $2.00/1K sessions; $0.10/1K requests.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: 300,000 API sessions/month and 5,000,000 API requests/month included. 100 GB hosting. SLA guarantee. Team account support. Overage: $1.50/1K sessions; $0.08/1K requests.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Prepaid annual or quarterly contract. Custom session/request quotas with soft limits (no automatic overage bills). Volume discounts. Unlimited hosting. Contact sales.

vendors.name: LocationIQ
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://locationiq.com/pricing fetched twice 2026-06-14. Plan names, monthly costs, daily request limits, and rate limits all confirmed from page content. Annual billing provides 2 months free (approx. 17% discount).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5,000 requests/day, 2 req/sec, 60 req/min. Includes Geocoding, Routing, and Static Maps APIs. Limited commercial use — attribution link required. 1 access token.

plans.name: Maps Lite
plans.notes: 10,000 map views/day, 15 req/sec. Access to Map APIs only (not Geocoding/Routing). Full commercial use, multiple tokens, IP restrictions. Annual billing gives 2 months free (~17% off).

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: 25,000 requests/day, 20 req/sec. All APIs (Geocoding, Routing, Maps). Soft daily limits up to 200% of daily quota. Annual billing gives 2 months free (~17% off).

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: Most popular plan. 60,000 requests/day, 22 req/sec. No per-second map limits. Priority email support. Annual billing gives 2 months free (~17% off).

plans.name: Growth Plus
plans.notes: 7.5 million requests/month (no daily limit). 30 req/sec. Soft monthly limits with 5-day bonus usage. Annual billing gives 2 months free (~17% off).

plans.name: Business Plus
plans.notes: 30 million requests/month. 40 req/sec. Priority live support, dedicated AWS endpoints. Annual billing gives 2 months free (~17% off).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Up to 10 billion requests/day. Dedicated servers, custom contracts and SLAs, wire transfer payments. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Geoapify
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://geoapify.com/pricing fetched twice 2026-06-14. Plan names, monthly costs, daily credit limits, rate limits, and isochrone/isodistance caps all confirmed from page content. 1 API request = 1 credit for simple requests (e.g. Geocoding). Batch requests reduce costs up to 50%.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 3,000 credits/day (~90K/month). Up to 5 req/sec. Limited commercial use. Isochrones up to 15 min, isodistances up to 10 km. No credit card required.

plans.name: API 10
plans.notes: 10,000 credits/day (~300K/month). Up to 12 req/sec. Commercial use. Isochrones up to 30 min, isodistances up to 20 km. Email support.

plans.name: API 25
plans.notes: 25,000 credits/day (~750K/month). Up to 15 req/sec. Commercial use. Isochrones up to 30 min, isodistances up to 20 km. Email support.

plans.name: API 50
plans.notes: 50,000 credits/day (~1.5M/month). Up to 20 req/sec. Commercial use. Isochrones up to 60 min, isodistances up to 60 km. Priority support.

plans.name: API 100
plans.notes: 100,000 credits/day (~3M/month). Up to 25 req/sec. Commercial use. Isochrones up to 60 min, isodistances up to 60 km. Priority support.

plans.name: API 250
plans.notes: 250,000 credits/day (~7.5M/month). Up to 30 req/sec. Commercial use. Isochrones up to 60 min, isodistances up to 60 km. Priority support.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Starting from $860/month. Unmetered credits, dedicated endpoint and servers, isochrones up to 120 min, isodistances up to 200 km. Final price depends on volumes, rate limits, and SLA requirements.
